function.description: Add single-token liquidity to a Pendle market — deposits ONE token and receives the market's LP token, which earns swap fees and rewards until the market's expiry. LP is NOT a fixed-rate lock; after expiry it stops earning and only the principal side remains removable. Approval-gated; pins the canonical Pendle Router. REQUIRES a fresh matching pendle.lp.quote (direction add) first.
function.name: pendle__lp__add

amountIn.description: Amount of the payment token in human-readable units.

chain.description: Chain slug or id — one of Pendle's 11 chains (e.g. 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'base', 'bsc').

market.description: The Pendle MARKET (LP) CONTRACT ADDRESS — the LP anchor liquidity is added to or removed from.

tokenIn.description: The payment token CONTRACT ADDRESS to deposit (ERC-20; use WETH for ETH).
